label: Urban Location
description: City streets and architecture. Items tagged 'night' bake in night ambience and declare requires where explicit.

items.name: financial-district
items.text: A wide, immaculate street in a modern financial district, curtain-wall towers of green-tinted glass and brushed steel mirroring one another above granite plinths and flagpoles.

items.name: downtown-street
items.text: A downtown street of mixed eras, cast-iron storefronts beneath 1980s office slabs, steam drifting from a manhole grate past hydrants and parked delivery vans.

items.name: brooklyn-brownstones
items.text: A residential street of Brooklyn brownstones, high stoops and carved lintels behind wrought-iron railings, London plane trees arching over the parked cars.

items.name: gardens-by-the-bay
items.text: Amid the towering steel Supertrees of Gardens by the Bay in Singapore, ferny vertical gardens climbing the lattice trunks and the aerial walkway strung between canopies.

items.name: brutalist-concrete
items.text: Against monolithic brutalist architecture, raw board-formed concrete with visible formwork grain, deep window recesses stacked in stark repeating geometry.

items.name: central-park-path
items.text: A curving path in a landscaped city park, cast-iron lampposts and wooden benches beneath mature elms, skyline towers rising beyond the treeline.

items.name: shibuya-crossing
items.text: The center of the Shibuya scramble crossing, white zebra stripes radiating in every direction beneath stacked animated video screens and the station's glowing facade.

items.name: rain-slicked-street
items.text: A rain-slicked urban street after the shower has passed, streetlights and shop signs doubled in the dark mirror of the wet asphalt.

items.name: cobblestone-street
items.text: A quiet European cobblestone lane, each worn sett crowned with warm light from the windows above, shutters closed over silent shopfronts.

items.name: empty-boulevard
items.text: A wide, empty boulevard in a major city, darkened shop windows and banks of traffic signals cycling green to red for no one.

items.name: rooftop-parking-deck
items.text: The exposed top level of a concrete parking structure, painted bay lines and low parapet walls opening onto a glittering high-rise skyline beyond the ramp housing.

items.name: suspension-bridge-leds
items.text: The deck of a modern suspension bridge, programmed LED washes climbing the main cables to the tower saddles, lane lines and expansion joints running into the dark.

items.name: parking-garage-fluorescent
items.text: An empty multi-storey parking garage, ramped concrete decks under stark repeating fluorescent tubes, painted arrows and bay numbers on the floor.

items.name: railway-station-forecourt
items.text: The grand, empty forecourt of a historic railway station, gothic brick clock tower and arched entrances washed in warm floodlight.

items.name: neon-highway
items.text: An elevated expressway through a cyberpunk metropolis at night, holographic billboards and stacked neon signage doubling in the wet asphalt between the lane lines.

items.name: old-town-square
items.text: An empty paved square in a historic old town, arcaded facades and a worn fountain at its centre.

items.name: modern-road-tunnel
items.text: Inside a modern road tunnel, repeating overhead light bars and clean segmented walls curving away.

items.name: highway-underpass
items.text: Beneath a massive concrete highway underpass, stacked geometry of piers and beams framing the space.

items.name: streetlamp-avenue
items.text: A deserted avenue under warm streetlamps, pools of light marching down the empty sidewalks.

items.name: haussmann-boulevard
items.text: A Parisian Haussmann boulevard, cream limestone facades with wrought-iron balconies under zinc mansard roofs, café awnings and a Morris column on the corner.

items.name: amsterdam-canal
items.text: An Amsterdam canal street, gabled brick houses leaning shoulder to shoulder, bicycles chained to the humpback bridge rail, houseboats moored on dark green water.

items.name: london-mews
items.text: A cobbled London mews, pastel-painted former carriage houses with glossy garage doors, climbing roses trained around coach lamps.

items.name: graffiti-alley
items.text: A sanctioned graffiti alley, layer upon layer of wildstyle pieces and paste-ups climbing the brick, empty spray cans along the gutter line.

items.name: elevated-rail-street
items.text: A street beneath elevated rail tracks, riveted steel columns striping the road with hard parallel shadows, a train rumbling across overhead.

items.name: signboard-canyon
items.text: A dense signboard canyon in the manner of old Kowloon, stacked neon and lightbox signs projecting over the roadway from both sides, cables sagging between them.

items.name: chinatown-gate
items.text: A chinatown street through a tiled paifang gateway, red lanterns strung between bilingual shop signs, roast ducks hanging in a steamed-up restaurant window.

items.name: european-tram-street
items.text: A cobbled European street with tram tracks curving through it, catenary wires crosshatching the sky between pastel facades, a cream-and-red tram rounding the corner.

items.name: streetball-court
items.text: A chain-link streetball court squeezed between brick buildings, painted key and faded sponsor lines on cracked asphalt, netless hoops below a full-wall mural.
